content: {"reasoning": "Prior auth is required and missing, but this payer offers no retroactive authorization and no peer-to-peer, so those actions are unavailable/rule-violating; there is no denial on the table yet, so an appeal is also premature. The claim data itself is correct (valid code pairing, correct COB order, active eligibility), so correct_and_resubmit would be a wasted touch, and billing the patient or writing off the balance now would forfeit collectible payer money. The only way to progress is to put the claim in front of the payer, and attaching the strong documentation (0.90) supports medical necessity for the no-auth review and preserves a solid appeal record if it denies.", "action": "submit_with_records"}
